name: cam edit: the sample bracket, CAM manager, planned and generated
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('basMountBracket', { stage: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); await m.run('camManager'); m.mfg.cam.recognize(); m.mfg.cam.planAll(); const p = await m.mfg.cam.generate({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ paths: p.paths.length > 0 }); })()

name: cam edit: the facing operation's toolpath editor — arc leads, stay-down linking, a deleted and a reversed pass; the program is made again with them
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { passesOf, cutLength } = await import('/src/cad/cam-edit.js'); const cam = m.mfg.cam.camOf(); const op = cam.ops.find((o) => !['drill','peck','spot','tap','chipBreak'].includes(o.type)); m.actions.pmSet('camTab', 'ops'); await m.actions.pmCommand('cam.selOp:' + op.id); await sleep(200); const before = m.mfg.cam.program().paths.find((x) => x.op === op.id); const n0 = passesOf(before.moves).filter((x) => x.pts).length; document.querySelector('[data-cam-edit]').open = true; m.actions.pmSet('camEdit.leadIn', 'arc'); m.actions.pmSet('camEdit.leadOut', 'line'); m.actions.pmSet('camEdit.link', 'stay'); await sleep(150); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.cam-passes .cam-row').length; await m.actions.pmCommand('cam.pass:del|0'); await m.actions.pmCommand('cam.pass:rev|1'); await sleep(150); const edits = m.mfg.cam.camOf().ops.find((o) => o.id === op.id).edits; const p = await m.mfg.cam.generate({ quiet: true }); const after = p.paths.find((x) => x.op === op.id); return JSON.stringify({ rows: rows === n0 || rows > 0, edits: Object.keys(edits).sort(), changed: JSON.stringify(after.moves) !== JSON.stringify(before.moves), deleted: edits.deleted[0] === 0, open: Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-cam-edit][open]')) }); })()

name: cam edit: simulation after the edits; clearing them gives back the generated path
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.mfg.cam.simulate(); const s = m.mfg.cam.simulation(); await m.actions.pmCommand('cam.resetEdits'); await sleep(100); const op = m.mfg.cam.camOf().ops.find((o) => o.id === m.state.editing.opId); await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ sim: Boolean(s), cleared: !op.edits }); })()
